target_dtype_note: Original runtime observed BF16 native/block disagreement. Both native/spec remain FP32, no BF16 speed claim.

target_hf.revision_note: Recorded in the original resource_manifest.json. tools/download_assets.py pins this revision. Base weights are not bundled. Starting-point and model_512 are not needed for inference.

WorldVLA.note: Pass checkout root via --upstream-repo; it provides model, data, xllmx and libero_util. Do not use default Rynn branch.

LIBERO.setup_note: Install pinned source and configure its user-local LIBERO config.yaml to checkout assets, bddl_files, init_files and benchmark_root. Missing config may cause an interactive prompt. No dataset download is needed for evaluation.

prompt: Original What action should the robot take to <instruction>? with only current or previous/current agentview images; no wrist or action history
rich_condition: same target prefill: last hidden, language mean, four pools per previous/current image (duplicate current at first query), explicit 8D proprio
draft: three independent 2-layer TransformerDecoder branches (xyz, rotation, grip), 128 hidden, 4 heads, one call per branch per query
verification: one target causal block call with official row-specific mask and shifted logits; references are candidate-prefix-conditioned, NOT independent native AR
recovery: first rejected whole step: crop KV and mutable init_input_ids to accepted prefix minus one token, original AR suffix through EOS; no refine, no fixedpoint, no tail reuse
scope: Thresholds describe controller goal increments, not measured achieved pose or geodesic rotation. Legacy canonical run init45 is exposed development, not finaltest. No score or speedup guarantee.
release_changes: Extracted inference-only local dependency closure, parameterized paths/device/CLI, removed GPU ownership locks and machine paths; preserved original branch architecture, target implementation, mask/shift/crop/gate algorithms. Training supervisor and legacy unrelated pipelines intentionally not imported.
